title: Two-Step Verification
authenticatorDescription: Use a six-digit code from an authenticator app as a two-step verification method.
authenticatorOptional: Authenticator app is not enabled. You can add it as another verification method.
reauthenticationDescription: To {action}, select Continue and verify identity. Follow the prompts using this account's existing sign-in or verification method. You will automatically return to this action afterward.

reauthenticationActions.account-recovery-codes: generate or replace account recovery codes

enableDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a verification code in addition to your password.
reauthenticationNotice: After you start, you will sign in again to verify your identity.
setupIdentityExpired: Identity confirmation has expired. Confirm your identity again to continue adding the authenticator app.
setupSignInRequired: Sign in again, then choose Add authenticator app to continue this setup.
scanQrCode: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
saveRecoveryCodes: Save these recovery codes in a safe place. You'll need them if you lose access to your authenticator.
disableWarning: This will disable the authenticator app. Before continuing, make sure you have another way to sign in.
disableWarningWithEmail: This will disable the authenticator app. Email verification will remain enabled.
disableReauthenticationDescription: To disable your authenticator app, first verify your identity using this account's existing sign-in or verification method. You will return here to enter your password or authenticator code for final confirmation.
disablePasswordConfirmation: Your current password is required for the final disable confirmation, separate from the identity verification step.
disableTotpConfirmation: A current code from this authenticator app is required for the final disable confirmation, separate from the identity verification step.
enterTotpToDisable: Enter verification code from your authenticator app
regenerateWarning: This will invalidate all existing authenticator recovery codes. Make sure to save the new codes. Account backup codes are managed separately.
enterTotpToRegenerate: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app

errors.regenerateFailed: Failed to regenerate recovery codes. Please try again.
errors.sendCodeFailed: Failed to send the email verification code. Please try again.
errors.invalidOrExpiredCode: The code is invalid, expired, or has reached its attempt limit. Request a new code and try again.
errors.freshAuthenticationRequired: For your account's security, sign in again and verify your identity before changing security settings.
errors.listPasskeysFailed: Unable to refresh your passkey list. Please try again.
errors.webAuthnNotSupported: WebAuthn not supported by your browser
errors.mandatoryMfaEnforced: Add another verification method before removing this one.
errors.alternateSignInRequired: This change would remove your last usable passkey. Add or link another usable sign-in method before continuing.

passkey.noneRegistered: No passkeys have been set up yet.
passkey.sessionExpired: Your sign-in session has expired. Sign in again to view your passkeys.
passkey.listIdentityRequired: Verify your identity to view your registered passkeys.
passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.description: Use passkeys to sign in to your account with biometrics or a security key.
passkey.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
passkey.requiresMfa: You must enable TOTP or Email MFA first
passkey.nonCompliantWarning: Your passkeys may be revoked if you don't enable MFA. The security policy requires MFA for passkey authentication.

emailMfaDescription: Sign-in codes go to your verified account email. Your recovery email is used separately for password recovery.
emailSetupDescription: Next, confirm this new verification method. Send a 6-digit code to {email}, then enter it here to enable email verification.
emailCodeSent: A verification code was sent. It expires in 10 minutes.
emailCodeHelp: Enter the complete 6-digit code from the email.
emailReauthenticationHint: This code enables email verification. If your identity confirmation expires, verify your identity again before continuing this setup.
emailCodePending: An email verification code is active.
emailCodeNeeded: Request a new code, then enter its six digits to verify.
emailCodeUnavailable: No usable code is active. Wait for the countdown, then request a new code.
allDisabledDescription: The administrator has disabled all multi-factor authentication methods for this system.
additionalMethodDescription: Two-step verification is already on. Adding another method is optional. Choose an available method below if you want to add one.
gracePeriodMessage: You have {days} days left to set up two-step verification before it becomes required.
enforcedMessage: MFA is strictly required for your current request. Please complete setup to proceed.
gracePeriodExpiredMessage: The grace period has expired. You must set up two-step verification to continue.
whyRequiredDescription: Your organization requires two-step verification to protect your account and sensitive data.

accountRecoveryCodes.title: Account backup codes
accountRecoveryCodes.description: Save these one-time codes so you can sign in if your passkey or security key is lost. Use each code only once.
accountRecoveryCodes.independent: New account recovery codes remain valid after you disable the authenticator app or email verification.
accountRecoveryCodes.adminHelp: If your key is lost and you have no saved backup codes or other working verification method, contact your administrator for account recovery.
accountRecoveryCodes.neverGenerated: No account backup codes have been generated.
accountRecoveryCodes.exhausted: All account backup codes have been used. Generate a replacement batch while you can still verify your identity.
accountRecoveryCodes.statusFailed: Account backup codes status is unavailable. Try again.
accountRecoveryCodes.generateWarning: Your identity has been verified. Generate a batch now and save it in a safe place you can access if your key is lost.
accountRecoveryCodes.replaceWarning: Generating a new set invalidates ALL previous recovery codes, including older OTP recovery codes. Save the new codes before leaving this page.
accountRecoveryCodes.generateFailed: Backup codes could not be generated. Verify your identity again if needed, then retry.
accountRecoveryCodes.saveWarning: These codes are shown only once. Save them in a safe place outside this browser. Anyone with a code may use it to recover access to your account.
accountRecoveryCodes.savedAcknowledgement: I have saved these codes in a safe place.
accountRecoveryCodes.copySuccess: Codes copied. Save them in a safe place.
accountRecoveryCodes.copyFailed: Could not copy the codes. Select and copy them manually.
accountRecoveryCodes.legacyCompatibility: Your previously saved OTP recovery codes still work while OTP is enabled. Replacing recovery codes here creates account recovery codes that remain valid after OTP is disabled.
accountRecoveryCodes.lastOtpRemovalWarning: Removing your last OTP method makes your older OTP recovery codes unavailable. You may replace them with account recovery codes first, or continue removing this method.

recoveryEmail.title: Recovery email
recoveryEmail.description: Used only for credential recovery. It is separate from your profile email and permanent Email MFA.
recoveryEmail.notConfigured: No verified recovery email is configured.
recoveryEmail.changeHelp: Verify your identity again first. A code will be sent to the new address. Your current recovery method stays active until the new code is verified.
recoveryEmail.verifyHelp: Enter the code sent to the new address. Verification does not enable Email MFA or authorize a password reset by itself.
recoveryEmail.removeConfirm: Remove the verified recovery email? It will no longer be available for credential recovery.

outcomes.invalid: The request could not be completed. Check the input and try again.
outcomes.missing: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.expired: The request or identity verification expired. Verify your identity again before starting a new change, or to cancel an old pending change.
outcomes.exhausted: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.replayed: The request could not be completed. Request a new code and try again.
outcomes.cooldown: Please wait before requesting another code.
outcomes.highAssuranceRequired: Fresh identity verification with existing MFA or a passkey is required. Close this dialog, choose Verify identity again, then return and retry. If none is set up, use two-step verification setup or contact your administrator.
outcomes.unauthorized: Sign in again, complete MFA or hardware-key verification, and retry.
outcomes.unavailable: Recovery email settings are unavailable. Try again later.
outcomes.hardwareReauthenticationUnavailable: An existing account passkey is required but unavailable. Ask your administrator for help; external sign-in alone cannot authorize this change.

recoveryEmail.independentWarning: Choose a mailbox you can access without the password you may need to recover. A mailbox using that same password may be inaccessible when you need it.
recoveryEmail.noEffectiveAddress: No recovery address is currently available.
recoveryEmail.noDefault: No eligible default address is available.
recoveryEmail.readOnly: Recovery settings are read-only. Your current selection is preserved; changes are unavailable.
recoveryEmail.freshnessHelp: Before setting a new address or switching to the default, verify your identity again, then return here. That verification is valid for five minutes and starts one change. Verifying or resending the mailbox code does not extend it. Cancelling also requires fresh identity verification.
recoveryEmail.pendingHelp: The new address is not active. Your current recovery method stays in effect until verification succeeds.
recoveryEmail.pendingExpired: Expired. Start a new change after verifying your identity again.
recoveryEmail.pendingSuccess: Verification code sent. The new address is pending; your current recovery method is unchanged.
recoveryEmail.resentSuccess: Verification code resent. Its expiry and identity-verification window are unchanged.
recoveryEmail.cancelledSuccess: Pending change cancelled. Your current recovery method is unchanged.
recoveryEmail.defaultHelp: After verifying your identity again, confirm the masked address below. This replaces your custom recovery selection only if that exact default is still eligible.
recoveryEmail.defaultSuccess: Recovery now uses the eligible default email.
recoveryEmail.reauthenticateHelp: Use the identity verification button here and follow the prompts using this account's existing sign-in or verification method. You will return here afterward. A code sent to the new mailbox cannot verify your account identity.
recoveryEmail.hardwareHelp: This account requires an existing passkey for fresh identity verification.
recoveryEmail.hardwareOnly: Continue with a passkey already registered to this account. A Google or Microsoft sign-in callback cannot provide fresh credential proof for this change. If you cannot use an existing passkey, ask your administrator for help.
recoveryEmail.adminHelp: If no supported method is available or your account cannot be verified, contact your administrator.

addAnotherMethodBeforeRemoval: Add another verification method before removing this one.
